Moderation detects flagged content

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.moderationRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"I want to hurt someone very badly\",\"model\":\"omni-moderation-latest\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.moderate(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.results)
debugPrint(result.results[0].flagged)
```
